patch_description: Restructures the solver into a three-stage pipeline: (1) a staggered hex-lattice seed generator, (2) an exact LP-based radius solver (maximize sum of radii subject to wall and pairwise constraints) built with vectorized numpy broadcasting and a sparse CSR constraint matrix, and (3) a deterministic hill-climb that perturbs individual centers and re-solves the LP, accepting improvements. The LP replaces the suboptimal shrink-to-fit heuristic (which leaves slack on most circles), and the vectorized constraint assembly makes each LP solve fast enough to afford many hill-climb refinement steps within the time budget.
